blind.B1: Series holds 18 rat gastrocnemius libraries. HCR vs LCR (generation 33, 3 males each, archived untrained muscle, S2.1.1.p1) is a selectively bred intrinsic-capacity comparison with no training arm; it is associational, not an exercise intervention, but it is the paper's exercise-capacity question (title, S3.1). Analyze only if labelled associational.
blind.B2: HCR vs LCR, n=3 vs 3 (S2.1.1.p1); paper reports 434 DEGs, 257 up in HCR / 177 up in LCR (fold change > 1.5, q < 0.05; S3.1.p1).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one gastrocnemius per animal, 3 + 3 distinct animals. Title/description suffix 1-3 is a replicate index, not an animal key (packet A expression check: not_supported).
blind.B4: Paper does not state a joint vs pairwise model; it only says DEGs came from Cuffdiff (S2.3.1.p1). Pairwise HCR vs LCR is the natural reading.
blind.B5: S3.1.p1: 'fold change > 1.5, q < 0.05' (strict >). S2.5.p1: 'p-value < 0.05 (two-sided, adjusted by Benjamini-Hochberg)' from Cuffdiff output; S2.5.p2: FDR < 0.05 where applicable. Count: 434 (257 up HCR, 177 up LCR).

checks.evidence: Packet B design: estimand_type associational, role secondary, caveat 'not an effect of exercise training'. Matches B1.
grp HCR 3 / LCR 3, GSM4697795-800, same n as S2.1.1.p1; the 12 HRT/LRT samples are excluded with a stated reason (analysed in the training case).
treatment HCR, control LCR, as in S3.1.p1 (257 up in HCR). Gene directions Fam163a, Fosb, Cyp2j4 up in HCR and Ranbp3l, Igfn1 up in LCR agree.
No repeated animals (B3); pairing_key_candidate flag is a replicate index and the expression check says not_supported (same-key r 0.236 vs 0.117 other, p 0.18).
Two-group ~ grp fit, which is the only structure possible for this case; paper is silent.
All male, one tissue. Lane is crossed (HCR L1,L1,L3; LCR L1,L1,L3) and recorded; exploratory ~ grp + lane run added.
featureCounts integers (integer fraction 1.0), DESeq2 via pydeseq2. frac_p>0.9 = 0.108 and frac_p<0.05 = 0.048, no pile-up flag.

padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > log2(1.5)=0.5849625, strict, as in S3.1.p1; audit rule padj < 0.05 also recorded. The mechanical flag (pvalue<0.05 & |lfc|>1 gives 399 vs paper 434) is not a close fit; ownership check says the authors' Cuffdiff list reproduces 434 = 257/177 under the stated rule.
Same contrast (HCR vs LCR), 81 vs 434 with the method deviation (DESeq2 vs Cuffdiff) declared. HANDBACK does not claim agreement; Ppm1h contradiction and two unmapped genes are listed.
No stop or refusal in this case.

summary: 该案例是未训练 HCR 与 LCR 的先天运动能力比较（3 对 3），被正确标注为关联性而非运动干预效应，分组、方向、阈值（FC>1.5、q<0.05，严格大于）与论文一致。没有重复测量，泳道（lane）已交叉平衡并另做了探索性检验。DESeq2 得到 81 个 DEG，对比论文 Cuffdiff 的 434 个，该方法偏差已如实声明，未发现阻断或重要问题。
